title: Questions that made us fall in love all over again

slides.title: Questions that made us *fall in love* all over again
slides.sub: Ask them slowly. The answers get better as you go.

slides.text: What was your *first impression* of me? Honestly.
When did you know *this was serious?*
What’s a memory of us you *replay in your head?*
What do I do that makes you *feel safe?*
What’s something about me you’d *never change?*
What do you want *us* to be like in ten years?

slides.title: Save this *for a slow night.*
slides.sub: Then send it to your person and answer number five first.
